name: @HOME in Curacao (Remote Worker Program)

requirements.blocker_text: Must be employed under contract by a foreign-registered company, or be a business owner/partner in a foreign-registered entity, or provide freelance/consulting services primarily to foreign clients. Working for or being employed by a local Curacao company/employer is not permitted.
Requires valid international travel insurance with COVID-19 coverage, and a return ticket.

evidence_required.document: Online application via www.athomeincuracao.com (Dutch, English, or Spanish)
Employment contract, or business ownership/partnership proof, or freelance client documentation
Proof of payment to the Ministry of Finance bank account: ANG 535 (approx. US$294) per applicant, including family members aged 12+
Valid international travel insurance with COVID-19 coverage and return ticket

outcome.duration_length: 6 months, extendable once to a maximum of 1 year

sources.title: Curacao Tourist Board -- @HOME in Curacao: eligibility, ANG 535 fee (paid to the Ministry of Finance), 6-month duration extendable to 1 year total, insurance requirements (site copyright and payment destination confirm government/statutory operation)

notes: NEW ROUTE, part of Curacao's initial build. Treated as tier-1 despite sitting on a non-government-TLD domain, on the same basis used for Dominica's windominica.gov.dm and Montserrat's montserratremoteworker.com this session: the page identifies the Curacao Tourist Board (a statutory tourism authority) as operator, and payment is explicitly directed to a Ministry of Finance account -- flagged for transparency, not silently assumed. The source explicitly states holders 'will not become a resident' -- this status does not build toward permanent residence or naturalisation, unlike ordinary work/residence permits, hence leads_to_pr and switchable_to are both empty/false. work_rights is 'restricted': work is authorised only for the foreign employer/clients, never a local Curacao employer.
